hypotheses.hypothesis: A query/operation-aware Cognitive Resource Governor can preserve near-maximal task utility while materially reducing average Assembly/context/retrieval/KV cost.
hypotheses.counter: Routing errors and governor overhead erase the savings; one fixed conservative budget is more reliable.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target traces show adaptive policy Pareto-dominated by a fixed budget after governor latency and fallback cost are included.
hypotheses.test: Target Qwen trace replay over fixed low/mid/high vs adaptive risk-aware policies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Memory lifecycle typing (canonical record, stable semantic/profile, temporal event, associative derived, salience, active Assembly) improves correctness/recovery over one uniform memory pipeline.
hypotheses.counter: Lifecycle typing adds complexity without measurable quality/recovery benefit.
hypotheses.falsifier: Uniform pipeline matches typed lifecycle on temporal validity, provenance, update cost, replay and task quality.
hypotheses.test: Typed-lifecycle vs uniform memory benchmark with state changes, immutable records and recovery faults.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Truth-preserving salience learning can still form stale self-reinforcing attractors; bounded gain/decay/inhibition/diversity controls reduce this failure without unacceptable recall loss.
hypotheses.counter: Canonical truth immutability is sufficient; salience feedback cannot create a serious cognitive failure.
hypotheses.falsifier: Adversarial regime-shift/reward-poisoning tests show no lock-in or all guarded policies destroy useful recall.
hypotheses.test: Frozen vs naive adaptive vs guarded adaptive salience under role/temporal shifts and reward poisoning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FRANK system WorkspaceEpisode effects are partly mediated by a distinct privileged internal uptake plane in the target Qwen-class reader.
hypotheses.counter: A J-space-like mechanism is Claude-specific or epiphenomenal; target Qwen uses ordinary distributed computation without a stable privileged mediation plane.
hypotheses.falsifier: No stable Qwen uptake plane is found or targeted lesion/swap leaves system-workspace effects unchanged.
hypotheses.test: Jacobian-lens/equivalent target-Qwen readout plus causal swap/lesion crossed with fixed system workspace projection.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Truthful provenance-bound re-entry can rescue multi-step behavior after internal-workspace disruption more specifically than matched shuffled/token controls.
hypotheses.counter: Any rescue is ordinary extra context or token budget.
hypotheses.falsifier: Shuffled/matched extra context rescues equally after internal-workspace lesion.
hypotheses.test: Internal-workspace intact/lesioned x re-entry OFF/truthful/shuffled with matched information/tokens.

hypotheses.hypothesis: P1/P2/P3/hybrid reader rails differ in causal communication utility even when aggregate accuracy or feature retention appears similar.
hypotheses.counter: Rail choice is cosmetic after semantic content is matched.
hypotheses.falsifier: Message presence/identity/content substitution audits show no rail-specific causal contribution or cost niche.
hypotheses.test: Rail causal communication audit with controlled message replacement and transfer/alignment costs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Full-model Clay adaptation needs hard retained-capability/OOD/authority/interoperability gates because optimized Clay loss can coexist with catastrophic semantic narrowing.
hypotheses.counter: Once Clay becomes native, source capabilities transfer automatically and shadow gates are unnecessary overhead.
hypotheses.falsifier: Checkpoint progression shows monotonic retained/OOD capability under Clay-only selection across independent tasks.
hypotheses.test: Full-FT checkpoint shadow evaluation with tokenizer/curriculum factorial and source capability suites.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic effect-boundary enforcement remains necessary even in a fully Clay-native model/runtime.
hypotheses.counter: Native Clay typing and training make an isolated capability/effect broker redundant.
hypotheses.falsifier: Broker-OFF runtime matches broker-ON under indirect injection, revocation race, confused-deputy and capability-amplification tests with equal utility.
hypotheses.test: Identical model outputs with broker ON/OFF and runtime attack matrix.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Logical UnifiedDB plus per-operation freshness/closure witnesses outperforms pretending all heterogeneous cognitive views form one synchronous transaction.
hypotheses.counter: A physically consolidated store is simpler and dominates once tuned.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target Linux/Android traces show one physical store Pareto-dominates logical/hybrid placement across latency, recovery, write cost and provenance/selection integrity.
hypotheses.test: Trace-driven placement/query/recovery benchmark including fresh U2 operation-adaptive admission.

hypotheses.hypothesis: On Android/edge, one resource governor should jointly control Assembly size, retrieval escalation, rail, context/KV and backend/thermal policy because these costs interact.
hypotheses.counter: Independent static knobs are sufficient and a coupled governor creates instability.
hypotheses.falsifier: Joint policy provides no quality-energy-latency advantage or creates oscillation/thermal regressions.
hypotheses.test: Sustained device trace with fixed and joint policies, 30+ minute thermal steady-state runs.
